QF.id: VIII Introduction to Clearing and Settlement System_73

question.text: The eligibility norms (net worth and deposits) for a clearing member that clears and settles trades for other trading members in the derivatives segment are:

answer.text: Net worth of at least Rs. 300 lakhs plus a security deposit of Rs. 50 lakhs and an incremental deposit of Rs. 10 lakhs per additional trading member
Net worth of at least Rs. 100 lakhs with no additional deposits
Net worth of at least Rs. 500 lakhs with deposits based on traded volume
No specific net worth requirement; only margins are required

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the source, a clearing member that clears for other trading members must meet a net-worth norm of at least Rs. 300 lakhs. In addition, a security deposit of Rs. 50 lakhs is required, plus an incremental deposit of Rs. 10 lakhs for each additional trading member taken on for clearing. The Trap: Net worth and deposits are distinct buckets - Rs. 50 lakhs and Rs. 10 lakhs per TM are deposit components and should not be mis-read as part of the net-worth figure itself. Note: Source: NISM-Series-VIII workbook (Dec 2025), page 152.
